verdict.rationale: A probe confirms turbopuffer serves an llms.txt at https://turbopuffer.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a docs header and summary), and its content includes topical entries such as PrivateLink and per-test namespaces. Individual docs pages are also served as agent-friendly markdown (.md), e.g. quickstart.md, vector.md, fts.md and api-overview.md. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, first-party guidance on pointing agents at them, and a root docs.md (which returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://turbopuffer.com/llms.txt # turbopuffer docs
turbopuffer embeds your text on writes and queries and you don't integrate an embedding provider at all
